concept: Eighteen rooms on an old pearl-diving island in the Gulf; a scroll dive to the oyster banks and a booking engine.
look: Gulf dawn and lagoon light, nacre and teak, calm documentary travel photography
palette: nacre white, lagoon teal, deep sea blue, teak

shots.title: Hero dhow
shots.prompt: Cinematic luxury travel photograph at dawn: a traditional wooden Gulf dhow with a furled lateen sail glides across glassy pale turquoise water toward a low island of bleached coral-stone houses with lime-plaster walls and palm-frond barasti shades, a few date palms, a thin teak jetty. Soft pink and pearl-grey sky, light mist on the water, calm reflections. Wide composition with open sky on the right for a headline. Editorial, quiet, timeless, no people visible, no text, no logos.

shots.title: Hero jetty
shots.prompt: Editorial luxury travel photograph: a woman in a long white linen kaftan stands at the end of a weathered teak jetty at dawn, seen from behind, wind moving the linen, looking out at a wooden dhow moored on pale turquoise water. Soft mother-of-pearl light, pastel sky, mist on the horizon. Calm, timeless, Arabian Gulf. Face not visible. No text, no logos.

shots.title: Aerial
shots.prompt: Aerial drone photograph of a small low island in the Arabian Gulf: a cluster of bleached coral-stone houses with flat roofs and palm-frond shades, a few date palms, a white sandbank curling into a lagoon in gradients from pale aqua to deep teal, the wake of a wooden dhow arriving at a thin jetty. Late morning light, crystal clear water, luxury travel editorial. No text.

shots.title: Night
shots.prompt: Blue hour photograph of a small coral-stone island village turned into a quiet luxury hotel: warm lantern light in doorways and on flat roofs, palm-frond shades, two wooden dhows moored by a teak jetty, the first stars over a deep indigo sky reflected on calm water. Serene, cinematic, Arabian Gulf. No people, no text.

shots.title: Room barasti
shots.prompt: Interior photograph of a luxury beach villa built of woven palm-frond (barasti) walls and ceiling on a teak frame: a low platform bed in natural white linen, a sand-coloured lime-plaster floor, rope details, a woven mat, a brass lantern, wide doors open onto turquoise shallows and white sand. Soft morning light through the palm weave casting patterned shadows. Editorial hotel photography, no people, no text.

shots.title: Room merchant
shots.prompt: Interior photograph of a suite in a restored pearl merchant's coral-stone house: thick lime-plastered walls with arched niches, a carved teak door, low majlis seating in natural linen, a brass lantern, a woven palm mat, a small courtyard with a ghaf tree visible through an arch, afternoon light shafts. Quiet heritage luxury, editorial hotel photography, no people, no text.

shots.title: Room nakhuda
shots.prompt: Photograph of a rooftop captain's suite on a coral-stone house at dusk: a private flat roof terrace with low cushions in indigo and natural linen, a brass ship's lantern, a teak sea chest, a wooden ladder, palm-frond parapet shade, the view over the small island and wooden dhows moored on calm water under a peach and lilac sky. Luxury hotel editorial, no people, no text.

shots.title: Room lagoon
shots.prompt: Photograph of a minimalist coral-stone pavilion with a private plunge pool at the edge of a turquoise lagoon: a linen daybed under a palm-frond shade, stone steps into the water, a teak side table with a carafe and two glasses, white sand, calm dawn light and soft reflections. Luxury hotel editorial, no people, no text.

shots.title: Room dana
shots.prompt: Interior photograph of a two-bedroom residence in a restored coral-stone house: a long dining table of reclaimed dhow teak set for breakfast with dates, bread and karak tea in small glasses, a cabinet with mother-of-pearl inlay, lime-plaster walls, a tall wooden wind catcher opening above, morning light. Warm family luxury, editorial hotel photography, no people, no text.

shots.title: Dive surface
shots.prompt: Underwater photograph just below the surface in clear turquoise water: the wooden hull and keel of a traditional dhow seen from below, sunlight rays streaming down through the water, the bright rippled surface above, tiny bubbles, sandy shallows faintly visible far below. Cinematic, serene, high clarity. No people, no text.

shots.title: Dive diver
shots.prompt: Cinematic underwater photograph: a free diver in simple traditional white cotton clothing descends head-down along a vertical rope weighted with a stone, in deep clear teal water lit by sun rays from above, a woven basket at the waist, seen from the side at a distance as a graceful silhouette, small bubbles. Heritage pearl diving, serene and respectful. Face not visible. No text.

shots.title: Dive bank
shots.prompt: Underwater photograph of an oyster bank at twelve metres: a sandy sea floor with clusters of pearl oysters, patches of sea grass and small coral heads, a few small silver fish, soft blue-green light with faint sun rays from above, gentle particles in the water. Calm, natural, high detail. No people, no text.

shots.title: Pearl
shots.prompt: Macro photograph of an opened pearl oyster resting on wet pale sand, its shell lined with iridescent mother-of-pearl nacre in silver, rose and green, holding a single luminous natural pearl. Soft daylight, shallow depth of field, drops of seawater. Luxury, calm, high detail. No text.

shots.title: Grid dining
shots.prompt: A 2x2 grid of four separate photographs separated by thin white gutters, one consistent warm editorial food style on an island in the Arabian Gulf. Top-left: grilled hammour fish with lime and saffron rice on a hammered brass tray. Top-right: a long table under date palms set with linen, lanterns and clay dishes at dusk by the sea. Bottom-left: dates, karak tea in small glasses and golden luqaimat on a coral-stone roof at dawn. Bottom-right: the morning catch on crushed ice at a teak jetty, a fisherman's hands. No faces, no text.
